simple.meaning: פָּלַל (pâlal) appears 84 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with prophetic witness. The surrounding account also brings the name into conflict.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Numbers, Deuteronomy, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, and 13 more, beginning at Genesis 20:7. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as prophetic witness, Egypt, Israel.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows פָּלַל through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.short: to judge (officially or mentally); by extension, to intercede , pray
